name: Wicked Apparel
old_description: Wicked Apparel – Your Design on Quality Apparel – Made Wicked Easy
about:
Wicked Apparel operates from Manchester, New Hampshire. The company's copyright notice dates to 2014, marking its presence in the custom apparel market. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery on a range of garments including t-shirts, sweatshirts, polo shirts, dress shirts, hats, and bags. It also builds and manages online fundraising stores, handling order processing and fulfillment so clients can sell custom apparel directly to their audiences. The company describes itself as a one-stop shop for decorated apparel with integrated e-commerce.

Its customer base spans local businesses, sports teams, schools, and non-profit organizations across New Hampshire. Named clients include Northeastern Sheet Metal, Inc., a sheet metal fabricator; Shuttles Auto Sales, an automotive dealership; Covenant Fire Protection, a fire safety contractor; and Mill City Energy, an energy sector firm.

Wicked Apparel emphasizes competitive pricing, fast turnaround times, and a do-it-yourself online design tool as key differentiators. The company states that quality, cost, and customer service come first, aiming to let clients focus on their core operations while it handles branding and apparel logistics.
